scenarios.description: One of two review groups fails while the other returns a clean empty review.
Verify pass throws after a high finding was produced.

knownDefects.status-not-complete: runReview sets filesTruncated on the result but reviewStatus stays "complete" (only failedGroups and truncatedFiles are considered), so describeReviewExecution and incompleteReviewFailure report a complete run for a partial file list.
knownDefects.no-approval: reviewFailed() in publishReview ignores filesTruncated, so with auto-approve enabled and all AI threads resolved a review over a truncated file list is APPROVED.
knownDefects.failure-surfaced: incompleteReviewFailure returns null for this run, so the step does not fail even though the changed-file list is partial.
knownDefects.summary-says-incomplete: The summary shows the APPROVED banner (with only a small FILE LIST TRUNCATED notice) because the decision banner keys off reviewStatus, which is complete.
knownDefects.report-status: buildReviewReport derives status from reviewStatus and failedGroups only, so the machine-readable report says complete while coverage.filesTruncated is true.

scenarios.description: GitHub file listing hit the safety cap, so the diff is partial; the model saw only what was listed and found nothing.

Head recheck call fails, so freshness cannot be proven.
